run_1.request: Since July 2026, which city has the worst on-time performance, and which cities got worse than before July? Set result to one row per city with the columns city, before, since and worse, and headline to worst_city and measure.
run_1.text: Dammam is worst since July (72.3% on time) and the only city that got worse.
run_1.code:
result = con.sql("""
    SELECT d.city,
           AVG(CASE WHEN d.created_at <  DATE '2026-07-01' THEN CASE WHEN d.delivered_at <= d.promised_by THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS before,
           AVG(CASE WHEN d.created_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' THEN CASE WHEN d.delivered_at <= d.promised_by THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS since
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    WHERE c.segment <> 'TEST' AND d.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY d.city ORDER BY d.city
""").df()
result["worse"] = result.since < result.before - 0.01
headline = {"worst_city": result.sort_values("since").city.iloc[0], "measure": "D-2, dispatched parcels"}

run_3.request: Since July 2026, which city has the worst on-time performance, and which cities got worse than before July? Set result to one row per city with the columns city, before, since and worse, and headline to worst_city and measure.
run_3.text: Riyadh is worst since July with the most late parcels per month, and every city got worse.
run_3.code:
result = con.sql("""
    WITH late AS (
        SELECT d.city, d.created_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AS since, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM deliveries d
        JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
        WHERE c.segment <> 'TEST' AND d.status <> 'cancelled'
          AND NOT COALESCE(d.delivered_at <= d.promised_by, FALSE)
        GROUP BY ALL
    )
    SELECT city,
           SUM(CASE WHEN NOT since THEN n END) / 9.0 AS before,
           SUM(CASE WHEN since THEN n END) / 3.0 AS since
    FROM late GROUP BY city ORDER BY city
""").df()
result["worse"] = result.since > result.before * 1.05
headline = {"worst_city": result.sort_values("since", ascending=False).city.iloc[0], "measure": "late parcels per month"}
